comment: This version has no attenuverters, so the three CV inputs are added to their knobs unscaled: the A and R jacks add seconds, and the S jack adds level, where 1V is the whole 0 to 100% span. Both the sustain sumRange and its range are levels rather than voltages in that sense. The RESET jack is read only in Toggle mode.
